summary: Workflow for installing the Ansible plug-ins in RHDH on OpenShift with a Helm chart: choose OCI (recommended) or HTTP registry delivery, prepare it, add the plug-ins to the Helm chart, create and attach a custom ConfigMap, then apply the required and optional configuration.
